summary: The package Tabs with one pill that slides and stretches under the active tab instead of each tab repainting its own background.
use: Segmented controls, tab bars and filters where the eye should follow the selection from one option to the next.
spec: `MotionStage` with `label="Tab indicator: a pill slides under the active tab"` and `loop={1800}`
The active trigger's `offsetLeft` and `offsetWidth` are written to `--x` and `--w`; the pill reads `transform: translateX(var(--x))` and `inline-size: var(--w)`
`transition: transform 360ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1), inline-size 360ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1)`; no transition before the first measure and under reduced motion
A `ResizeObserver` re-measures when the list resizes

motion.property: transform: translateX and inline-size of the pill
